run_preprocess_data: run the HITL data preprocessing pipeline on a collection path to extract best and failed episodes
run_count_files_in_subfolders: run a count of files in each subfolder of a given directory and print the distribution
run_order_session_dirs_by_timestamp: run a sort of session directories by their start timestamp from gzipped session JSON files
run_copy_files_to_directory: run a batch copy of a list of files into a target directory, recreating it if needed
run_compute_derived_metrics: run computation of episode-based metrics including human robot task division and exploration efficiency
